## Intro
This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to retrieve data from the PPG (Photoplethysmography) sensor of a Teslasuit device. The page is structured to help developers understand the process of initializing the Teslasuit API, connecting to a device, accessing the PPG subsystem, and streaming data such as heart rate and HRV (Heart Rate Variability).

## Code for HRV data
````python
from teslasuit_sdk import ts_api
import teslasuit_sdk.subsystems.ts_ppg

def main():
    print("Initializing Teslasuit API...")
    api = ts_api.TsApi()  # create the central API object

    print("Waiting for a Teslasuit device to connect...")
    device = api.get_device_manager().get_or_wait_last_device_attached()

    print("Accessing the PPG subsystem...")
    ppg = device.ppg  # PPG sensor is located on the right shoulder of the suit

    # start_raw_streaming must be called before requesting any processed data
    print("Starting raw PPG data streaming...")
    ppg.start_raw_streaming()

    print("Waiting for HRV data (Mean R-R)...")
    while True:
        # get_hrv_data_on_ready blocks until fresh HRV data is available
        # Note: valid data requires ~30 s of streaming after start_raw_streaming
        hrv_data = ppg.get_hrv_data_on_ready()
        print("Mean R-R Interval:", hrv_data.mean_rr)  # mean R-R interval in milliseconds


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
````

## Expected output
```
Initializing Teslasuit API...
Waiting for a Teslasuit device to connect...
Accessing the PPG subsystem...
Starting raw PPG data streaming...
Waiting for HRV data (Mean R-R)...
Mean R-R Interval: 750
```


## Code for Heart rate data
````python
from teslasuit_sdk import ts_api
import teslasuit_sdk.subsystems.ts_ppg

def main():
    print("Initializing Teslasuit API...")
    api = ts_api.TsApi()  # create the central API object

    print("Waiting for a Teslasuit device to connect...")
    device = api.get_device_manager().get_or_wait_last_device_attached()

    print("Accessing the PPG subsystem...")
    ppg = device.ppg  # PPG sensor is located on the right shoulder of the suit

    # start_raw_streaming must be called before requesting any processed data
    print("Starting raw PPG data streaming...")
    ppg.start_raw_streaming()

    print("Waiting for Heart Rate data...")
    while True:
        # get_data returns the latest processed PPG node data
        # nodes[0] refers to the first (and only) PPG sensor node on the suit
        node_data = ppg.get_data()
        print("Heart Rate:", node_data.nodes[0].heart_rate)  # heart rate in BPM


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
````

## Expected output
```
Initializing Teslasuit API...
Waiting for a Teslasuit device to connect...
Accessing the PPG subsystem...
Starting raw PPG data streaming...
Waiting for Heart Rate data...
Heart Rate: 72
```
